          "text": "2 fans there's no rgb and they don't turn on...update the pump isn't working is there a way i can exchange for another one",

        {
          "id": "epqa-B08WC58NKZ-review-d1bcc7baea3d3f5f",
          "label": "review",
          "text": "it comes with 2 fans by default, a full range of mounting kits for both amd and intel and an easy to understand setup for both platforms.pros:compatible with all modern platforms (minus threadripper, and lga2011 or other xeon sockets)sleek clean designfans provided with splitter adapter2 thermal paste options available when newcons: (mostly cosmetic)rgb is automatic on when installedno on block rgb controller or standalone unitno adapter for the rgb headermy machine is mainly a cad workstation, it has no windows and isnt built for interior aesthetics, it also only has 12v rgb headers on board which this is not compatible with.",

          "sha256": "e7f5b9f97d7ac1618f1db64c99aa0b16d33002e600c15a950cd5c2561e5318ea"
        },
        {
          "id": "epqa-B08WC58NKZ-review-c72dfe676fd730ac",
          "label": "review",
          "text": "also, all 6 included ek vardar fans are three prong standard argb with daisy chain ability.my largest complaint was that the rgb on the cooling block did not work out of the box, at all, whether it was connected directly to the motherboard or to the ek hub (included fan hub).what's more, the argb ek hub was a dud as well - the only thing that ever showed rgb light whatsoever was the ek lighting hub logo itself and even that was flickering and independent of the motherboard lighting scheme despite careful following of directions.since i don't have another pc to test on, i thought the mb may have had a faulty connector - so i replaced the mb with the same result!",
